title: Portuguese Frittata
description: A traditional Portuguese-style frittata with rich flavors and velvety texture. Perfect for a satisfying breakfast.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: Large eggs for a rich frittata

ingredients.name: rich
ingredients.notes: Rich cream for a creamy texture

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, portuguese seasoning, and a pinch of salt.
In a large skillet, heat the velvety sauce over medium heat.
Add the rich cream and stir until combined.
Pour the egg mixture over the cream mixture in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 18-20 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to loosen the frittata from the skillet and slide it onto a plate.
